description: Plan parallel-agent git worktrees from caller-supplied worktree facts: the ownership map, each tree's status, and which trees are safe to remove. Returns the plan only; git and the filesystem are never touched.

main_path.description: Path of the primary worktree, which is never cleaned up (optional)

stale_days.description: Inactivity threshold in days; beyond it a worktree is stale

worktrees.description: Worktrees to plan, in the caller's order

branch.description: Branch checked out in the worktree

dirty.description: Whether the worktree has uncommitted changes

last_activity_days.description: Days since the worktree last changed

owner.description: Agent or person who owns the worktree (optional)

name: plan_worktrees
